verdict.rationale: Poke documents a public API at poke.com/docs/api for sending messages programmatically from apps, scripts and automation tools, so external services can trigger and drive the assistant. The evidence shows only a message-sending surface, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, so the API's breadth and machine-readable documentation are unproven. Missing for 10: documented endpoint, auth and response reference, an OpenAPI spec, API coverage beyond sending messages (e.g. reading results or managing state), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Poke API allows you to send messages programmatically from your applications, scripts, and automation tools.
Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.
